title: Thomas L. German (1941-2023)
content: The world lost an extraordinary vector biologist and molecular plant virologist, friend, and colleague when Thomas L. German died suddenly on 27 August 2023. Tom made seminal contributions to the field of RNA biology, plant virology, and vector biology as a scientist and mentor. He was a skilled administrator, leading two different academic units as chair and serving as director of the Wisconsin Seed Potato Program at the University of Wisconsin (UW)–Madison. Tom was the quintessential mentor, guiding people at all stages of life and career, always finding time to listen intently and provide sage advice. He was a dear friend to many, an outstanding colleague known as a passionate scientist who believed deeply in the power of science and education to address the dramatic problems of the modern world. He is profoundly missed and his absence will be felt by his friends and colleagues in the scientific community for years to come.
